_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Apprentice robots and the chain that builds them (spec sections 3 and 14): the crew climbs from 1 robot at about player minute 20 to 100-200 at the launch point. Robots and their upgrades cost PARTS only. mastery_speed: a robot works a kind at rate x (base + per_level x Lumi's mastery of that kind), and not at all below min_level, so Lumi's hands set the pace of the whole crew. near_bonus: extra speed for crew in the district Lumi is in (the simulator treats the whole current district as 'within 80 m'). crew_cap: most robots in all at base level 1..6. chain: scrounger and assembler name the two robot types of the chain. Every hex that gets cleaned leaves buried parts in the ground (districts.json buried_parts_per_hex); a Scrounger carries `carry` of them to the base per round trip of trip_s + trip_s_per_ring x the district's rings seconds, from the open district with the most left, and when the ground is empty it carries nothing: crew growth follows cleaning. An Assembler turns Parts into one robot every assembly_s seconds, in the mix the player sets. Through cities 1 and 2 Lumi builds every robot by hand at the bench (the Scrounger of city 2 only supplies Parts); the Assembler arrives in city 3 and closes the chain; after that only the first robot of a type and further Assemblers are hand-built. haul_share: share of Lumi's bale carrying one hauler takes over. Tiers on Planet 1: rusty and repaired, per robot TYPE: repaired_mult = a repaired type's speed (work, carrying or assembling); the upgrade costs the type's repair_parts plus repair_per_robot x its build price for each robot already owned; robots of a repaired type cost repaired_build_mult x as much to build; repair_requires = the id that opens upgrades. types: kinds = pollution kinds the type can work; rate = units a second per rusty robot at speed 1.0; water_rate / plant_rate = hexes a second a tender waters or plants (planting uses seeds); hauls = carries Lumi's bales; parts = Parts to build one; parts_step = Parts added for each one already owned (only the Assembler: more Assemblers are costly); max = most of that type (absent = no limit but the crew cap); requires = id that must be owned; district = index of the district that must be open. Base levels also raise crew speed (upgrades.json base_N mods). The Drip working smog (misting the air) is this proposal's answer to the spec naming no smog robot.
